Francis Ngannou is a Cameroonian-French professional mixed martial artist who competes in the heavyweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC). He was born on September 5, 1986, in Batie, Cameroon.

Ngannou made his UFC debut in 2015 and quickly gained attention for his exceptional knockout power and striking abilities. He holds a 16-3 professional MMA record, with the majority of his wins coming by way of knockout.

Ngannou has faced some of the top heavyweights in the UFC, including Stipe Miocic, Junior Dos Santos, and Alistair Overeem. In 2018, he fought for the UFC heavyweight title against Miocic, but was defeated via unanimous decision. However, Ngannou rebounded with a standout performance, knocking out Jairzinho Rozenstruik in just 20 seconds in 2020.

Ngannou is known for his strong work ethic and humble personality outside of the Octagon. He has expressed his desire to become the UFC heavyweight champion and continues to train and improve his skills to achieve that goal.

Overall, Francis Ngannou is considered one of the most dangerous and exciting fighters in the UFC heavyweight division, and his knockout power makes him a formidable opponent for anyone in his weight class.
